summary: One declared recovery-route table per workflow definition is the only owner of cross-step correction. The closed two-trigger set (unhealthy_verdict and disproved_premise_at_complete) pairs each trigger with one engine-owned recovery action, the registration gate refuses an undeclared or non-producer route, the runtime cross-step reader is one function, and the artifact-staleness fold binds the production frontier to the declared target so only an accepted worker delivery or a typed target production direct action clears the bit. The 108 released versions keep their canonical bytes and digests and resolve their routes through a per-(ref, version) quarantine the liveness and conformance replay covers exhaustively; a new authored version declares its own table; CD-0172 and CD-0186 keep the complete-step supersede bound to implementation and break_fix with exact approval terminal.
title: Declared recovery routes preserve artifact truth
